messages:
simon: heads-up — customer X reported a 20-30% increase in median token latency on their Private cluster after last night's kernel selector change. saw it on /chat route. anyone digging in?
maya: looking now. I can reproduce on our staging private image with the same config. latency bump starts at ~seq_len 96.
lee: timeline: we rolled kernel selector to prefer `q4_0_fast` for long sequences, but for mid-length we now fall back to a slower generic kernel more often. kv-cache stats also show a small hit-rate regression.
maya: attaching quick pprof snapshot (trimmed):
```
# pprof top
50.2%  runtime/kernel_generic
23.1%  runtime/kv_cache_lookup
10.4%  runtime/dispatch_overhead
```
simon: interesting — dispatch overhead up too. could be extra branching for kernel decision per-request.
perf-bot: automated profile summary for 1938701234 produced: higher CPU self-time in kernel decision path; increased lock contention on kv cache map for heavy batching.
lee: I pulled Prom counters from the private prometheus (local scrape): `runtime_kernel_choice_total{kernel="generic",route="/chat"} 872` vs `runtime_kernel_choice_total{kernel="fast_q4",route="/chat"} 412` — pre-change was ~700/600.
anna: (ops) for air-gapped customers we can't just ask them to scrape a new endpoint. proposals: 1) add push gateway-style secure push from private control plane, 2) remote_write to customer's Prom with signed envelope, or 3) small agent that writes to their Grafana Loki stack.
maya: for instrumentation: propose adding labels: `kernel_variant`, `batch_size_bucket`, `kv_cache_hit` to token-level latency histograms so we can slice by those dims in dashboards. example metric: `token_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/chat",kernel_variant="fast_q4",kv_cache_hit="true",le="0.01"}`
simon: +1. also need per-route p50/p90 token breakdown panels and a kernel-selection heatmap (seq_len vs kernel chosen).
lee: quick config diff I tested to reduce contention: use sharded kv cache with 16 shards and relax expiry from 5m -> 8m. reduced kv lookup waits in pprof.
maya: tested on staging: latency returned to baseline for seq_len <128, but we see slightly higher memory use. tradeoff ok for customer X?
anna: customer X has strict memory caps. we need a safe fallback: enable adaptive shard count per-deployment or fall back to smaller batch sizes.
infra-bot: deploy bot: canary rollout started for kernel-selector fix to 10% private clusters at 23:10 UTC.
simon: ok action items — maya to add new prom labels and dashboard panels (PR + example queries), lee to push kv cache sharding patch, anna to draft air-gap metrics push proposal for legal/security review. I'll follow up with customer X.
maya: I'll open the PR and attach dashboard JSON for their Grafana (masked org ids). ping @lee for review.
lee: ack. I'll also run a micro-benchmark sweep across seq_len buckets and post results here.
perf-bot: alert: regression ticket created RW-4219 with profile artifacts attached.
simon: thanks team. small reminder: keep metric cardinality bounded — use coarse batch_size_bucket like 1/2/4/8/16+ and hash customer id if we need per-customer views.
maya: noted. I'll include cardinality strategy in the PR description. :thumbsup:
